Replay message types and slot-completion data for Tower, root advance, reset, and leader events.

# Purpose
This header defines the message types and constants used by the replay tile in the `discof` pipeline. It declares signal IDs such as `REPLAY_SIG_SLOT_COMPLETED`, `REPLAY_SIG_ROOT_ADVANCED`, `REPLAY_SIG_VOTE_STATE`, `REPLAY_SIG_RESET`, and `REPLAY_SIG_BECAME_LEADER`, which identify the events that the tile can send or receive. The file also defines data records for slot completion, root advancement, and Tower vote state, including slot metadata, block hashes, bank references, and timing fields. The `fd_replay_message` union groups all supported message payloads into one type for tile communication.
